newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Colombian peso plummets 15.55 by close.
newsitem.headline: Colombian peso plummets 15.55 by close.

text.p: Colombia's peso plummeted 15.55 to close at 1,025 to the dollar, its lowest level since Oct 1, interbank traders said Friday.
The crash came after a long period when only central bank intervention managed to offset the underlying strength of the peso.
Dealers blamed the fall on limited quantities of dollars flowing into the markets, coupled with heavy demand from the public sector and speculation by banks.
